requirements.title: Initial satellite acquisition
requirements.normative_text: The terminal shall acquire an authorized Asteria satellite and establish a forward-link lock within 120 seconds of cold start when the elevation is at least 20 degrees and the sky view is unobstructed.

requirements.title: Network authentication before service
requirements.normative_text: The terminal shall mutually authenticate with the Asteria network using device-bound credentials before permitting subscriber traffic on any bearer.

requirements.title: Active satellite handoff continuity
requirements.normative_text: The terminal shall complete an active make-before-break handoff between visible Asteria satellites with no more than 1000 milliseconds of user-plane interruption.

requirements.title: Loss-of-link recovery
requirements.normative_text: The terminal shall detect loss of the serving link within 2 seconds and restore an authenticated bearer through reacquisition within 30 seconds when a suitable satellite is visible.

requirements.title: Thermal transmit-power protection
requirements.normative_text: The terminal shall reduce RF transmit power when the power-amplifier temperature reaches 85 degrees Celsius and shall report the thermal-limiting state within 1 second.

requirements.title: Over-temperature safe shutdown
requirements.normative_text: The terminal shall inhibit RF transmission and enter a recoverable safe state before any monitored power-amplifier temperature exceeds 95 degrees Celsius.

requirements.title: Idle power management
requirements.normative_text: The terminal shall consume no more than 25 watts averaged over 10 minutes while registered, idle, and operating at an ambient temperature of 25 degrees Celsius.

requirements.title: Input-power interruption hold-up
requirements.normative_text: The terminal shall preserve security state and configuration without corruption through an input-power interruption lasting up to 100 milliseconds.

requirements.title: Authenticated secure boot
requirements.normative_text: The terminal shall execute only firmware images whose signature and rollback-protection metadata are validated by the hardware root of trust during boot.

requirements.title: Fail-safe firmware update
requirements.normative_text: The terminal shall authenticate each firmware update package and automatically restore the last known-good image when installation or post-update health checks fail.

requirements.title: Emergency-service traffic priority
requirements.normative_text: The terminal shall prioritize authenticated emergency-service traffic over best-effort subscriber traffic during congestion without bypassing network admission controls.

requirements.title: Post-emergency queue restoration
requirements.normative_text: The terminal shall restore configured subscriber traffic scheduling within 5 seconds after the emergency-service priority condition is cleared by the network.

requirements.title: Operational health telemetry
requirements.normative_text: The terminal shall report link state, serving-satellite identifier, power state, thermal state, and software version to the management service at least once every 60 seconds.

requirements.title: Position and time input
requirements.normative_text: The terminal shall ingest authenticated position and time data from the navigation subsystem and shall flag inputs older than 10 seconds as stale.

requirements.title: Adaptive link operation
requirements.normative_text: The terminal shall select only network-authorized modulation and coding profiles in response to measured link quality and shall prevent profile oscillation faster than once per second.

requirements.title: Device credential rotation
requirements.normative_text: The terminal shall install a network-authorized replacement device credential atomically and retain the prior credential only until successful authentication is confirmed.

components.name: Electronically Steered Antenna
components.description: Ka-band phased-array aperture, beam steering, and satellite tracking electronics.

components.name: RF and Baseband Modem
components.description: Radio-frequency chain, waveform processing, coding, and user-plane scheduling.

components.name: Network Control Processor
components.description: Acquisition, mobility, session control, navigation, and management-plane software.

components.name: Power Management Unit
components.description: Input protection, conversion rails, energy monitoring, and controlled power states.

components.name: Thermal Control Subsystem
components.description: Temperature sensing, fan control, throttling policy, and shutdown interlocks.

components.name: Hardware Security Module
components.description: Device identity, key storage, signature verification, and anti-rollback state.

components.name: Firmware Manager
components.description: Image download, staged installation, health evaluation, and recovery management.

risks.title: Inability to acquire or sustain a satellite link
risks.description: Pointing, timing, interference, or link-margin faults can prevent network access.
risks.mitigation: Validate acquisition envelopes and adaptive-link behavior under channel impairment.

risks.title: Service interruption during mobility
risks.description: Late or failed handoff can interrupt active subscriber and emergency sessions.
risks.mitigation: Exercise predictive handoff and bounded recovery across orbital visibility transitions.

risks.title: Thermal damage or unsafe enclosure temperature
risks.description: Sustained RF load or cooling failure can exceed component operating limits.
risks.mitigation: Use independent sensors, staged throttling, shutdown interlocks, and telemetry.

risks.title: Power instability or excess consumption
risks.description: Transient input loss or inefficient idle operation can cause resets or site overload.
risks.mitigation: Verify hold-up behavior, rail supervision, and bounded consumption in each power state.

risks.title: Unauthorized network access
risks.description: Compromised or mishandled credentials may allow impersonation or traffic exposure.
risks.mitigation: Bind credentials to hardware, require mutual authentication, and rotate atomically.

risks.title: Compromised or unusable firmware
risks.description: Malicious, corrupt, or incompatible firmware can subvert or disable the terminal.
risks.mitigation: Enforce signed boot, anti-rollback policy, redundant images, and health-based recovery.

risks.title: Emergency traffic starvation
risks.description: Congestion or scheduler defects can delay safety-critical emergency communications.
risks.mitigation: Reserve controlled priority treatment and test congestion entry and exit behavior.

test_cases.title: Cold-start acquisition envelope
test_cases.objective: Measure cold-start acquisition time across minimum elevation and nominal channel conditions.

test_cases.title: Mutual authentication access control
test_cases.objective: Verify valid authentication and confirm subscriber traffic is blocked for invalid credentials.

test_cases.title: Orbital handoff and recovery
test_cases.objective: Measure user-plane interruption during handoff and restoration after forced serving-link loss.

test_cases.title: Thermal protection thresholds
test_cases.objective: Exercise power limiting, telemetry indication, and safe shutdown at controlled temperatures.

test_cases.title: Registered-idle power consumption
test_cases.objective: Measure ten-minute average input power under the defined registered and idle condition.

test_cases.title: Secure boot and failed update recovery
test_cases.objective: Reject tampered images and verify automatic recovery after a failed update health check.

test_cases.title: Emergency congestion prioritization
test_cases.objective: Confirm admitted emergency traffic receives priority while best-effort traffic is congested.

test_cases.title: Navigation input freshness
test_cases.objective: Verify authenticated navigation inputs are accepted and stale inputs are flagged on time.

test_cases.title: Adaptive coding stability
test_cases.objective: Verify authorized profile selection and bounded transition rate under varying attenuation.
